correctness.rationale: The source proof uses the equal-radius spherical-Bessel addition identity, Legendre orthogonality and radial Plancherel on weighted L² to transform ∫J_{k+1/2}⁴ into (2π)⁻¹∫₀²P_k(1-u²/2)²du. Endpoint profile 1/(2u) is weighted-square-integrable; terminating hypergeometric expansion yields exact rational coefficients. The logarithmic limit follows from Darboux bulk, Bernstein endpoint bounds and a removable ε split: I_k~log(k)/(2π²k). Independently computed πI_0..4=1,7/15,11/35,3607/15015,30001/153153 and quadrature matched; they are not used as an infinite proof.
